rules.statement: In a situation where there is a plurality of landlords, the tenant has an obligation to pay each landlord their respective share of rent unless otherwise agreed.
rules.supporting_quote: For four or five months after Sitti Rowha's marriage Nazeer paid the brothers' share of the rent to the lady. Then disputes arose, and Sitti Rowha left the brothers and took up her residence with Keyath. Thereupon, Nazeer on behalf of the other brothers and himself, requested the defendant to pay the full half share of the rent to the sister.
